verdict: HARDENING TEST (eukaryote FBA-essentiality on a REAL FUNGAL PATHOGEN): on Candida albicans SC5314 (Mirhakkak-2021 curated GEM vs CGD curated inviable/loss-of-function essentiality), FBA single-gene-deletion essentiality is ENRICHED for experimental essentiality among the model's metabolic genes: OR 13.93 (Fisher one-sided p 0.00409), precision 0.857, recall 0.025, AUROC 0.5355. Contingency {'both': 6, 'FBA_only': 1, 'exp_only': 230, 'neither': 534}. Gate (OR>3 AND p<0.01): PASS. ID mapping 768/771 GEM genes -> CGD A22 systematic (3 mtDNA CM_ genes unmapped), no namespace artifact. This HARDENS the eukaryote->FBA entry beyond the n=1 model-yeast (GENERALIZE4) to a clinically relevant fungal pathogen. SCOPE: essentiality-enrichment only; in-silico FBA vs a curated published essentiality resource (not wet-lab); curated model is still a model; recall bounded by the metabolic subproteome; non-annotated genes treated non-essential (absence of evidence). S. pombe attempted but reported as an honest boundary (no open curated GEM with usable GPRs CPU-only).
